checks.text: The project so far, at the top: a card like Flex's film card, showing each phase as built, building (with a percentage) or planned. Clicking it opens what's built: the running app through Switchboard, and the latest walkthrough film. It keeps updating while the agent works.
The phase strip: done, now, next, one segment per phase, like a status page. It shows movement since you last looked, and a phase that hasn't moved in days shows as a raised hand (Hill Charts).
Since you last looked, in one line: "3 new decisions · 2 answered by the agent · Phase 6 → 7 · 9 commits" (Linear Pulse).

The health strip, which answers what you kept asking: tests green, anything uncommitted or unpushed, plan, sprint review and memory up to date, dev servers running (Switchboard knows), the last film and design review.
The agent's health note, rewritten at each gate: on track, at risk or off track, plus two sentences (Linear project updates).
What's owed: every commitment from your picks and the settled list, built or still to do.
